footer.brandLine: We bring photographs that matter back to life.

hero.title: Give your memories a second life.
hero.lede: We restore photographs that are damaged, faded or blurry — without ever betraying the original.
hero.trustLine: Your photos stay private. Never shared. Never sold.

value.line1: Some photographs tell a story no digital file will ever replace.
value.line2: We restore your images to preserve those stories — and give them a second life.

items.title: Handmade work, photograph by photograph
items.body: No automatic processing. Every image is looked at, corrected and checked by hand.

items.title: The original, preserved
items.body: We restore, we do not reinvent. Faces, light and the flaws that make the photograph remain.

items.title: Your memories belong to you
items.body: Private storage, deletion after processing, no commercial use.

how.title: Three steps, nothing complicated.

steps.title: You send us your photographs
steps.body: From your phone or your computer. Prints or files, it makes no difference.

steps.title: We restore them by hand
steps.body: Cleaning, reconstruction, colour correction, sharpening. Photograph by photograph.

steps.title: You receive your memories
steps.body: In high resolution, ready to download — or bound into a photobook delivered to your door.

how.reassuranceTitle: What if my photograph cannot be saved?
how.reassuranceBody: We tell you honestly, before we start. And you are not charged.

services.title: What we do with your images.

items.title: Digital restoration
items.body: Scratches, stains, tears, fading, blur, low resolution.

items.title: Premium photobooks
items.body: Your restored photographs, laid out and bound into a book meant to be passed on.

items.title: Colourisation
items.body: Accurate, documented tones for your black and white photographs. Never invented.

items.title: Album scanning
items.body: An album, a shoebox, an entire folder. We take care of everything.

packs.title: Choose how many photographs. We do the rest.
packs.options: extra photograph · complex restoration · black & white colourisation

photobooks.title: An album, not a file.
photobooks.lede: We restore your photographs, then lay them out and have them bound into a book you can leaf through, pass on, and leave on a table.
photobooks.options: extra pages · second copy · keepsake short film · premium box

gallery.title: Photographs we were told were lost.
gallery.lede: Every image was restored by hand. Hover or tap to compare.

finalCta.title: Send us just one photograph.
finalCta.lede: See what we do with it. Then decide.
finalCta.reassurance: Reply within 24 h · Free quote · No obligation

gallery.title: Transformation gallery
gallery.lede: Real photographs, restored in our workshop. Each example describes the work carried out.
gallery.emptyFilter: No transformation in this category yet.

faq.title: Frequent questions
faq.lede: If your question is not here, write to us: we answer within 24 hours.

trust.title: What you entrust to us is not ours.
trust.lede: You send us photographs of your family. Here is exactly what we do with them — and what we will never do.

journey.title: Encrypted receipt
journey.body: Your file goes straight to a private, encrypted space accessible to two people.

journey.title: Metadata removed
journey.body: Location data and device information are erased on arrival.

journey.title: Handled in-house
journey.body: No subcontractors, no external tools. The work happens in the workshop.

journey.title: Quality check
journey.body: Every image is reviewed before it is released to you.

journey.title: Delivered by private link
journey.body: A personal link, limited in time. Never a public space.

journey.title: Deletion
journey.body: Your originals are deleted 90 days after delivery. On request, immediately.

never: Show your photographs on this site without your written consent
Transfer or sell your files to anyone
Keep your originals beyond the stated period
Use your images for commercial purposes
Hand the work to an unidentified third party
trust.rightsBody: You may at any time request access to, correction, export or deletion of your data and files. Write to us: every request is handled within 30 days.
trust.securityBody: Encrypted storage in Europe, restricted and named access, logging of every consultation, daily backup. None of your files is publicly exposed.
